findings.note: Campaign site issue page, in the voice of his campaign; says he filed bills against the expanded firearms bans.

findings.passage: Defending Second Amendment Rights: Filed critical legislation to push back against expanded firearms bans and protect the constitutional rights of lawful gun owners.
findings.note: Campaign site lists defending Second Amendment rights as something he is doing.

findings.passage: Reform of expanded firearms bans and Second Amendment protections
findings.note: Campaign media page describes bills H.2715 and H.2716 in these words.

Lead filer of H.2716, An Act to repeal expanded firearms bans. Bill text repeals Section 16 and Section 71 of Chapter 135 of the Acts of 2024 and edits the large capacity firearm definition. Co-filers Gaskey and Lombardo. Referred to Public Safety committee.

Lead filer of H.2715, An Act relative to firearms features. Bill text removes parts of the 'Assault-style firearm' definition added by Chapter 135 of the Acts of 2024. Co-filers Gaskey and Brady. Committee report sent it to a study order.
